root_cause: The daily CI optimizer measured queue, execution and fan-out while two background learning/optimization workflows still generated pull_request runs themselves. The optimizer also lacked a monotone budget for direct PR workflow ingress points.
prevention: Run autonomous optimizer and daily self-evolution only on schedule/manual execution, centralize their regression contracts under Required, measure Required queue/total latency and direct PR workflow count daily, and permit the optimizer to lower the direct-PR budget only when the measured count shrinks. The optimizer can never raise that budget automatically.
